summary.text: Gary Byrne is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 47 since February 2022 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was selected in a Republican caucus to fill the vacancy created by Erin Houchin's resignation.

paragraphs.text: Byrne lives in Byrneville, Indiana, and his career experience includes co-owning and serving as president of Byrne Satellite, according to Ballotpedia.
Byrne assumed office in the state Senate on February 14, 2022.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture, Commerce and Technology, Education and Career Development, Homeland Security and Transportation, Senate Natural Resources, Utilities, and Veterans Affairs and the Military committees.
